nodes.label: Block editor with Markdown shortcuts; storage = CRDT block tree, Markdown only for export and agents (D-01)
Content: headings, lists, checklists, quotes, callouts, tables, code with highlighting, formulas, attachments, drawing blocks
[[ ]] links with autocomplete, backlinks, nested/smart tags; link graph not in MVP (stage 6)
Templates and daily notes
Instant full-text search with a local index on each client
Export: Markdown, PDF, HTML; handwriting exported as images
Import — not now (D-16), maybe later from Obsidian/Notesnook
Agent edits (D-10): agentEdit mark until accepted; accept = remove mark (undoable, synced); quiet green margin bar; text typed next to it does not inherit the mark
«Правки агента · Принять все · Посмотреть историю» banner above first block; per-block «Принять правку агента» in text menu
DSEditorModel.AgentEdits (iOS logic, web mirrors it)
D-45: note created entirely by agent — no line highlight, strip «Создано агентом {имя} · Понятно» via NoteMeta.createdByAgent (EditorView.createdByAgent, onAcknowledgeCreatedByAgent)
noteLink atom (noteId, label) shown as chip; literal [[Название]] rendered as link, tap opens note or offers to create it
iOS single tap on link chip/[[…]]/task circle/date chip acts without cursor or keyboard (reschedule menu); each is a VoiceOver accessibility element

New note title like Apple Notes: focusTitle(), Enter → body, empty title → defaultTitle «Заметка <дата>» (commitDefaultTitleIfNeeded), fully empty note not saved; only for notes created via «Новая заметка»
Notes-only mode (D-51): iOS taskDatesEnabled / web EditorHost.taskDates "full"|"inert" — date chips become inert labels, no reschedule; data unchanged

Photos and files (iOS, build 19): insert via «/», «+» menu (library, camera, file, paste) and iPad drag; downscale to 2560 px JPEG, files ≤100 MB, encrypted with note key, background upload (crypto.md §6)
Dictation/IME marked text inserted at cursor in its paragraph; no Markdown shortcuts on it; unreported field changes carried into document
Touch formatting (iOS): DSFormatBar over keyboard, EditorView.formatState/perform(_:), onStateChange
Marks without selection apply to the next typed text; mark active for selection only if on whole selection
Link: onLinkRequest → setLink(_:); editor does not read clipboard itself (avoids system «Paste» prompt)
Text menu «Формат» and «Стиль» — formatting works without the bar
«/» block menu (DSEditorModel.SlashCommands / DSSuggestionList; same items as web; ru/en keyword filter)
image block (attachmentId, width 0..1/null, alt, caption) unchanged; attachment created locally before upload, no temporary ids
nodes.rationale: Offline-first: document references real id immediately.

nodes.label: Photo inserted after cursor paragraph (empty one replaced), one undo step, local preview until saved
Photo paste (⌘V) and drag from Photos/Files handed to app; drop point sets cursor
Tap on photo zooms (VoiceOver «Изображение», label alt); no cursor or keyboard
Long press on photo — «Ширина» (¼, ½, ¾, full), app items (share, save, replace, caption), «Удалить»
iPad photo width handle snapping to ¼/½/¾/full with haptics, written on release, undoable
Quiet upload progress ring at photo bottom-right, no dimming; spins when size unknown
Caption/alt edited in app sheet «Подпись…»; «Заменить» swaps attachment; both undoable
Tap on file block (and VoiceOver activation) — app opens or shares the file (Quick Look)
«/» items «Фото»/«Файл» performed by app, shown only if app handles them; «/query» removed before call
Clipboard read order: photo only → HTML (Safari, Mail, Notes, Word, Pages, Google Docs) → RTF/RTFD → Markdown-like text → plain text

Rich paste rule — one mapping on web and iOS, equal to agent Markdown import: HTML → headings ≤3, marks, links, lists, tasks, quotes, callouts, code/mermaid/math, tables with align; formatting dropped; never a second title
nodes.rationale: Same clipboard yields same blocks on both clients; text of the rule owned by web-editor.

nodes.label: Markdown paste parsed by agent import rules (packages/agents/src/doc/markdown-import.ts, vector agents/create-note.json)
Pasted images: data:/RTFD decoded locally, http(s) downloaded by app (web: EditorHost.fetchRemoteImage) — remote URL never put in ; failure leaves link; file:/cid: skipped
nodes.rationale: Remote URL in would be blocked by CSP and leak user IP to third-party site.

nodes.label: Paste quirks: Google Docs <b style="font-weight:normal"> not bold; Word mso-list lists restored with nesting; list → tasks only if every item has checkbox; figcaption → caption; cell align from align/text-align
Paste into title — single-line text; into code block — text as is; into table cell — one line
«Вставить без форматирования» (edit menu, ⇧⌘V iPad; Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+V web) — plain text only
One paste — one undo step; first pasted paragraph continues text before cursor, last joins text after; empty target paragraph not left above
Shared paste vectors packages/test-vectors/vectors/paste/cases.json checked by both CIs (web ct/pasteVectors.spec.tsx, iOS DSEditorModelTests)
Unknown/invalid nodes, attrs, marks never deleted or rewritten; shown as is or «Неподдерживаемый блок»; opening writes nothing
nodes.rationale: y-prosemirror by default deletes schema-invalid elements — agent code blocks were lost on 2026-10-26.

nodes.label: «Один title» repair rules (document-model §4): drop empty duplicate titles; drop empty paragraphs before title; restore older paragraph (UUIDv7 blockId) into empty title; empty doc untouched — one idempotent Yjs transaction, not undoable
EditorCommands.repairTitles() (iOS, source .system; read-only notes not repaired, R-03)
Round-trip test on a note built like an agent writes it (open writes nothing)
Table column alignment: cell attribute align (left/center/right) on tableHeader/tableCell; cell edit changes only edited text; setColumnAlign
iOS keyboard: «Скрыть клавиатуру» button (isEditingText, dismissKeyboard()), interactive dismiss; pen unaffected
Scroll to caret without jumps: system auto-scroll off, minimal scroll keeps caret line above keyboard and palette with one-line margin
Header (cover, note line, agent banner) height changes while typing compensated by scroll; drawing margin computed from window height, not editor
While finger on text (selection handle, scrolling) editor never auto-scrolls; applied after lift
iOS: UIKit + TextKit 2 (not WebView)
Web: TipTap (ProseMirror) + Yjs
Shared CRDT document schema as contract (architecture/data-model.md), checked by packages/test-vectors
nodes.rationale: Both editors operate on the same CRDT structure.

nodes.label: @datascratch/web-editor DatascratchEditor React component embedded by apps/web; state entirely in Y.Doc
TipTap + y-prosemirror (field "content"); blockId (UUIDv7) per block node, unique taskId; ids reset on paste; link mark stores only href
«/» and [[ menus anchored to caret: follow scroll, open upward if no room, hide when caret off-screen
Web title API: EditorApi.focusTitle(), EditorHost.defaultTitle(), EditorApi.fillEmptyTitleIfNeeded() — names only new notes
Document start read as is (non-title first, two titles, no title) — ProseMirror no longer «fixes» it on first edit (bug 2026-10-26)
Web input: Markdown shortcuts (#, -, 1., [], >, !>, ```, $$, ---, #tag), «/» menu, [[ autocomplete, glass format toolbar
Block handles by input: hover for mouse/trackpad, single quiet handle after tap for touch (menu, long-press drag), never for Apple Pencil
Tasks: checkbox, scheduled/deadline chips (overdue red), context menu (reschedule, deadline, complete, cancel, open, move, delete)
Web agent edits: calm fill, glass banner «Правки агента · N блоков · Принять все», per-block «Принять»; createdByAgent prop with onAcknowledgeAgentCreated
Collaborator cursors via awareness (y-protocols); awareness change swaps cursor layer only
One Y.UndoManager on content and strokes — strokes undone with text, each stroke its own step

Note style & paper (smooth/dots/grid/ruled): line step = body line height in whole px (26 px @17 px), baseline-aligned, all lines and blocks multiples of step; setNoteStyle/setNoteCover/setNoteBackdrop; formatVersion newer → read-only
EditorHost callbacks (attachment URL, upload, open attachment, note card data, open/search/create notes, tag click, task actions, fetchRemoteImage)
Web image/file insert: block appears instantly with local preview + quiet progress ring, same blockId later gets attachmentId; «Повторить»/«Удалить» on error; uploadAttachment(file,{onProgress})
EditorApi.pickImage() / insertFiles(files); PenToolbar.onInsertImage
Mermaid and KaTeX loaded lazily on first display
iOS formula/Mermaid sizing by real drawn bounds (12 pt / 8 pt margins); callout icon inside plate (14 pt)
iOS scroll after open: notes ≤40 000 chars laid out fully; late block height changes deferred until scrolling stops, top text stays in place
Inline $…$ shown as KaTeX (source when cursor inside), document unchanged; prices like «$5 и $10» not formulas
Editor UI from @datascratch/ui: PenToolbar, FormatToolbar (ColorPanel, LinkPanel), SuggestionMenu, task calendar, .ds-task-check, dateLabel
Showcase: pnpm --filter @datascratch/web-editor dev (port 5174) — two «devices» with cursors, «Правка агента» button, width slider for stroke reflow
